name: Nylas
description: Email, calendar, contacts and meeting notetaker API for AI agents, with a hosted MCP server of 38 tools, a CLI and SDKs for Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and IMAP accounts.

skills.name: Send and Read Email
skills.description: Lists, searches, reads and sends email in connected Gmail, Outlook or IMAP mailboxes through one API or MCP.

skills.name: Manage Calendar Events
skills.description: Creates, updates and lists events and checks availability across Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars.

skills.name: Search Contacts
skills.description: Searches, lists and creates contacts in a connected account from the API, MCP server or CLI.

skills.name: Send a Meeting Notetaker
skills.description: Sends a Notetaker bot to a video meeting to record and transcribe it, then fetches the results.

skills.name: Provision Agent Inboxes
skills.description: Creates Agent Accounts, Nylas-hosted mailboxes for agents, on your own domain or a free nylas.email subdomain.
